signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.invalid: Enter a valid email and password.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable. Try again shortly.

guide.title: Getting started
guide.description: Sign in to use the application. You can close this guide and open it again at any time.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.description: Choose a password of at least 8 characters. We email a link to confirm your address.
signup.done: Check your inbox: we sent a link to confirm your email.

resend.title: Confirm your email again
resend.description: Enter your address and we email a new confirmation link if the account is waiting for one.
resend.done: If that address is waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.description: Enter your address and we email a link to choose a new password.
forgot.done: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: The link works once. Every device is signed out when the password changes.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.description: Press the button to confirm your email address.
confirm.done: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in.

errors.invalid: Enter a valid value in every field.
errors.password: The password needs at least 8 characters and at most 72 bytes.
errors.link: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: This is unavailable. Try again shortly.
